name: st-styling-0822-rerun
title: In-game styling (0.8.22): the re-run after the review packet (the false passes, ST5, ST13 and the bursts that began early)
requires: The XF test profile with the bridge's autonomous -writes build staged (0.8.22 with overlay.set); the runner sets config.ini's [overlay] enabled and diagnostics once and restores the file at the end.
A private fixtures file (--fixtures): mo2 {exe, profile, executable, arguments: -skipStartScreen}, game_dir, staged_mod, save, cet_overlay_key (Ctrl+` here), commit_floor_gb.
Borderless windowed, the game window in front; Windows' Do Not Disturb on (focus-taking toasts stopped the Borg 4 key press).

Every row verifies its named state through the bridge before each capture (bridge_info's status and chip, overlay_state's cet_open and motion, ui_state's question) and checks its surface is in frame after it; bursts start only once their surface shows. A judged row ends CAPTURED, awaiting XF · Studio's UI review, never PASS.

Left out until the bridge has their hook: ST8-dark-paused (cet.panel press), ST5-dark (cet.panel press), ST6-dark-paused (cet.panel press), ST7-dark-diagnostics (cet.panel diagnostics_open), ST3-dark-settle (cet.panel press), ST8-light-paused (cet.panel press), ST2-light-tones (overlay.set diagnostics_cpu_ms), ST5-light (cet.panel press), ST6-light-paused (cet.panel press), ST7-light-diagnostics (cet.panel diagnostics_open), ST3-light-settle (cet.panel press); regenerate (bun tools/sessions/make-batches.ts) once the catalogue has it.
